name: Gale Offshoots
text: Every 3rd spin hurls a small cyclone in a random direction: 4 m, 40% damage, pierces. Each stack adds one cyclone; Cyclone damage is 15% lower (paid once).

name: Vortex Lure
text: Enemies inside 1.6x the radius are dragged 30% closer each spin; every further stack adds 15% (max 5 m). The radius is 10% smaller (paid once).

name: Gathering Storm
text: Replaces the spin: charge for 2.0 s while standing still (moving restarts it), then release the storm at 2.2x radius and 3x damage. A second stack charges in 1.5 s and releases at 3.6x.

name: Ricochet
text: The arrow bounces to the nearest enemy once per stack for 60% of the damage that landed, and it no longer pierces.

name: Volley Stance
text: The shot fires 3 arrows per stack in a 20 degree spread per stack; each arrow deals 65% and pierces nothing.

name: Glacial Lance
text: Each enemy pierced adds 30% damage per stack; the shot's cooldown is 15% longer.

name: Twin Flame
text: Each cast adds one more ball per stack at a random angle for 35% of the shot's damage; the main ball deals 15% less.

name: Split Ash
text: On impact the ball splits into 2 more balls per stack, at 30 then 60 degrees, for 45% damage; every shot has a 25% smaller impact radius.

name: Pyromantic Focus
text: The cast is 20% slower and deals 60% more damage per stack, with 25% more impact radius per stack.

name: Fan the Flames
text: The aura's radius is 8% bigger per stack for every burning enemy inside, up to 40% per stack. Its burn deals 10% less.

name: Pyre of the Faithful
text: Standing still for 1 second: the aura deals 80% more damage per stack. Its radius is 15% smaller and moving cancels the bonus.

name: Cinder Trail
text: Every aura tick burns the ground behind you for 1.5 s: 25% of the aura's damage per stack every 0.5 s. The aura itself deals 10% less.

name: Glacial Echo
text: The nova repeats 0.6 s later, once per stack, at 50% of its damage. The echo cannot freeze.

name: Convergence
text: Hits at the edge of the nova deal 40% more damage per stack and drag enemies 2 m toward the centre. Centre hits are unchanged.

name: Deep Freeze
text: The nova's freeze lasts 50% longer per stack. Its cooldown is 20% longer.

name: Toxic Bloom
text: A poisoned enemy that dies leaves a cloud for 3 s: 50% of the strike's damage per stack every 0.5 s within 3 m.

name: Venom Spread
text: When a poisoned enemy dies its poison jumps to one enemy within 4 m per stack. A corpse jumps only once.

name: Serpent's Patience
text: Standing still for 2 s: the next strike deals 50% more damage per stack and adds 2 poison stacks per stack. Moving resets the timer.

name: Static Field
text: Every jump leaves a spark zone for 1.5 s: 25% of the jump's damage per stack every 0.5 s within 2 m. The chain has one jump fewer.

name: Overcharge
text: The chain gains 2 jumps per stack, but each jump loses 25% instead of 18%.

name: Storm Anchor
text: The last enemy hit is stunned for 0.6 s per stack and takes a second hit 0.4 s later for the last jump's damage per stack.

name: Razorwind
text: The spin leaves a blade trail behind you: 1.5 s, 50% of the spin's damage every 0.5 s. One patch per metre.

name: Momentum
text: +2% spin damage per enemy hit, up to +20%. Resets 2 s after the last hit.

name: Iron Cyclone
text: The spin is 25% wider and deals 15% more damage; you move 30% slower while it runs.

name: Twin Orbit
text: Two blades orbit at 1.2x radius for 40% damage; the inner 40% of the radius is never hit.

name: Blood Whirl
text: Critical hits inside the spin heal 1% of maximum Life. Critical chance is 20% lower.

name: Vacuum Cut
text: Every 5th spin knocks enemies back 2 m; that ring deals no damage.

name: Afterimage
text: When no enemy is left in the spin it leaves a ghost cyclone for 1.5 s at half radius and damage; 1 s before it can return.

name: Sacrificial Pyre
text: While an enemy burns you lose 1.5% maximum Life/s; each kill inside heals 1% (max 4%/s). Off below 15% Life.

name: Immolation
text: A burning enemy that dies explodes for 25% of its maximum Life in 3 m; the blast cannot ignite.

name: Zealot's Covenant
text: The aura slows enemies 20%. Its burn deals 20% less.

name: Ashen Veil
text: With 3+ enemies burning, you take 10% less damage. The aura is 15% smaller.

name: Kindle
text: Burning enemies take +6% more damage per second burning, up to +30%. The aura's burn deals 15% less.

name: Smouldering Step
text: A dash leaves burning ground for 2 s. Your skill cooldown is 30% longer.

name: Last Rites
text: Under 30% Life the aura deals double damage for 4 s (once per 20 s) and you do not regenerate.

name: Shatterpoint
text: Hits on a frozen enemy deal +50% and burst into 3 shards at 20%. One shatter per freeze.

name: Winter's Grasp
text: Where the arrow expires it leaves a 2 s frost patch that slows 40%. The patch deals no damage.

name: Hunter's Mark
text: Marks the farthest enemy; hits on it splash 25% damage in 2 m. One mark at a time.

name: Frostbite
text: Each hit on a frozen enemy adds +8% freeze chance. The arrow deals 15% less damage.

name: Sleet Step
text: +10% Movement Speed for 2 s after a hit. No damage bonus.

name: Ice Prison
text: Every 3rd hit on the same enemy roots it 1 s. The first two hits cannot freeze.

name: Cold Snap
text: A frozen enemy that dies freezes enemies within 3 m for 0.5 s. Shatter damage is 30% lower.

name: Rolling Ember
text: The ball bounces once per pick; the bounced hit does not ignite.

name: Ignite Bloom
text: An ignited enemy that dies explodes for 50% of the hit that killed it; only while the ignite runs.

name: Ember Familiar
text: Each stack adds an ember orbiting you; the embers take turns lobbing a 40% fireball every 3 s. Your own casts deal 10% less.

name: Meteor Call
text: Fireballs fall from the sky after 0.8 s: 1.2x damage in a 1.4x radius, growing with each pick. Each extra projectile adds its own impact point 4 m away; the spare balls are only animation.

name: Wildfire
text: The ignite spreads to one enemy within 2.5 m every second. Ignite damage is 20% lower.

name: Ash Cloud
text: The impact leaves a ground smoke cloud and you take 20% less damage inside. Each pick makes it longer, larger and stronger (cap 8 s / 60% / 11 m). The cloud deals no damage.

name: Combustion
text: Each re-hit on an ignited enemy adds +15% damage; the bonus and the hit cap grow with every pick. It cannot refresh the ignite.

name: Frozen Bulwark
text: A 2 s ice field forms at the burst's edge and slows enemies 40%. It deals no damage.

name: Permafrost
text: The ground inside the ring stays frozen 3 s and slows 40%. The nova deals 10% less damage.

name: Rime Cascade
text: Hitting 3+ enemies refunds 30% of the cooldown. Single-target casts give nothing.

name: Ring of Winter
text: The ring is 25% wider but deals 25% less damage.

name: Fracture
text: Enemies killed by the nova burst into 3 ice shards. The shards cannot freeze.

name: Icebound
text: Enemies are rooted 0.4 s instead of frozen. No slow after the root.

name: Arctic Charge
text: Every 3rd cast charges for 1 s (rooted) and bursts 40% wider.

name: Shadowstep
text: Viper Strike deals +35% damage and adds one poison stack. Every further stack adds +35% and one more stack.

name: Corrosive Bite
text: Poisoned enemies take +10% damage per stack, up to +30%.

name: Twin Fang
text: The strike hits twice for 65% each. The first hit cannot poison.

name: Lethal Dose
text: Poison deals +25% more damage per stack, but lasts 35% less time (paid once).

name: Adder's Grace
text: +15% Movement Speed while an enemy is poisoned. The strike deals 10% less damage.

name: Haemorrhage
text: Poisoned enemies drop 1 extra gold.

name: Last Breath
text: A kill on a poisoned enemy refunds the strike's cooldown.

name: Forked Fate
text: The cast throws two bolts at once, each with half the jumps.

name: Conductivity
text: Hitting a stunned enemy spreads the stun to 2 neighbours. Stun lasts 25% less time.

name: Chain Lightning
text: Jumps reach 8 m and prefer an unhit enemy, but each jump loses an extra 10% damage.

name: Thunderhead
text: Every 4th cast calls a bolt on the densest pack for 1.5x damage. Cooldown is 10% longer.

name: Static Cling
text: Stunned enemies take +12% damage from everything. The first hit of a chain cannot stun.

name: Galvanic Rush
text: +10% Movement Speed for 1.5 s after a chain ends. Chain damage is 10% lower.

name: Ball Lightning
text: The bolt becomes a slow orb that zaps for 2 s; no chain jumps.
